cluster_stories.summary: Bloomberg’s Caroline Hyde discusses Nvidia's outlook as the company says it's now getting orders from China and is ramping up sales of its H200 chips. Plus, the CEO of Nvidia, Jensen Huang, calls OpenClaw "the next ChatGPT," sending Chinese AI stocks higher. And, Kalshi CEO Tarek Mansour gives an exclusive interview after Arizona filed criminal charges against the prediction market platform. (Source: Bloomberg)
